description: Bit crusher working on the eight bits of the digitised signal one at a time, clearing them or flipping them

params.text: Clears that bit of every sample, each press turning it off and on again
Flips every bit of the sample except that one, each press turning it on and off again; a bit that is already cleared is left alone

inputs.text: The left channel going into the crusher
The right channel going into the crusher
A trigger here turns that bit off, and the next one turns it back on
A trigger here turns that bit's flipping on, and the next one turns it off

notes: the signal is read as eight bits across -10V to +10V, and the jacks and buttons run from the least significant bit at the top to the most significant at the bottom
